howto.what: 它会把 Discord 适配器复制进 src/channels/、注册到 channel barrel,安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0,然后构建并跑注册测试;再引导你创建 Discord bot、粘贴 Bot Token、写入凭据并重启服务。之后 bot 能在 Discord 私信或服务器频道里跟你对话。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Discord 频道接入 NanoClaw(如走 /manage-channels)时接管;若你正在跑 /setup,它做完后会让你返回该流程。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Discord 频道

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token,请配置好
say.note: 校验后写入 .env 并重启服务

say.text: 帮我解析我的 Discord 私信频道

howto.what_en: It copies the Discord adapter into src/channels/, registers it in the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, then builds and runs its registration test. It also walks you through creating a Discord bot and storing its token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Discord channel to NanoClaw, or when wiring channels (e.g. /manage-channels); if you are mid-/setup, it tells you to return to that flow.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs the test

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token, please configure it
